Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Gao: Trial of nine (9) criminal cases involving 11 defendants
Mali.summary: Gao, 9 October (AMAP) The first session of the criminal chamber of the Gao High Court ended on 8 October 2026 in the City of Askias, noted AMAP . Started on October 6, this series of hearings aimed to deal with 9 major criminal cases involving a total of 11 defendants including the nature of the cases examined and all judged at the very first hearing of the criminal chamber of the Gao High Court, namely 2 murders, 3 pedophilia, 2 fatal strokes, 1 rape and 1 murder During these hearings, the Criminal Chamber of the Gao TGI pronounced sanctions commensurate with the criminal offences committed.

Mali.title: Fama takeover of Kidal: Choguel Maiga's reaction
Mali.summary: Capture of Kidal by the Fama: Choguel Maiga Kidal's reaction is no longer in the hands of the terrorists. This strategic town in northern Mali was recaptured by the Malian Armed Forces (Fama) on October 6, after a vast military offensive carried out with the support of the Russian partners of Africorps. From the prison of Koulikoro, the former Malian Prime Minister Choguel Maiga congratulated the FAMa for their shine .

Mali.title: Mali: "The army has its place in Kidal but regaining it does not end the violence", for the opposition coalition CFR
Mali.summary: In Mali, the army and its Russian partners in the Africa Corps retook Kidal in the north on 6 October from the Fla separatists and the Jnim jihadists, who had controlled it for more than five months. A victory for the transitional authorities who intend to restore the authority of the State throughout the territory . The CFR, a coalition of opponents in exile, also defends national sovereignty throughout the territory but advocates dialogue with armed groups.

Mali.title: Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit: Terrorist Positions Targeted and Accurately Addressed
Mali.summary: The announcement was made on October 7, 2026 by the General Staff of the Armed Forces which indicates that in the continuity of the offensive launched in the East Theater, the air-land operations conducted today made it possible to precisely target several positions of the armed terrorist groups . On the ground, according to the security source, the responsiveness of the units made it possible to obtain convincing results, in particular in Talhandak, where terrorist elements who had sheltered under a canopy were neutralized and their vehicle completely destroyed .

Mali.title: Mali: "The army has its place in Kidal but regaining it does not end the violence", for the opposition coalition CFR
Mali.summary: Mali: "The army has its place in Kidal but reconquering it does not end the violence", for the opposition coalition CFR In Mali, the army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps took over Kidal, in the North, from the Fla separatists and the Jnim jihadists, who had controlled it for more than five months. A victory for the transitional authorities who intend to restore the authority of the State throughout the territory .

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa precision strikes against terrorist bases in San, Takalot and Talhandak
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko In the continuation of the offensive launched in the Eastern Theater, the air-land operations conducted on Thursday, October 8, 2026 made it possible to target several positions of the armed terrorist groups.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Takalot, Talhandak and San: Several positions of terrorist groups struck down
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 9 (AMAP)– The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) destroyed a vehicle containing war materiel northeast of Takalot and hit a major logistics point in the Talhandak area, as well as a base housing terrorist elements northeast of San, during air-land operations conducted Thursday, October 8 as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces .

Mali.title: Month of Solidarity: President Assimi GOÏTA with the Dean of Bamako The inhabitants of the Troukabougou sector of Djicoroni Para, in Commune IV of the District of Bamako, woke up this Thursday, October 8, 2026 under an impressive security device.
Mali.summary: Very early in the morning, the staking of the elements of the Security Forces announced that this district would welcome a distinguished host, including the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, who sacrificed to a well-established tradition of the Month of Solidarity and the Fight against Exclusion, that is to say the visit of the highest authorities to the elderly It was in this spirit that the Head of State went to the bedside of the Dean of Bamako, Namory Keita.

Mali.title: In Mali, why the takeover of Kidal is a bitter-tasting victory for the junta
Mali.summary: It had been several days since a scent of reconquest floated in the air. On the morning of Tuesday, October 6, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by Russian elements of Africa Corps, retook the city of Kidal In a statement dated the same day, the Malian military authorities announced that they had engaged in "large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region" with a view to "neutralizing armed terrorist groups" and "destroying their sanctuaries".

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: The junta tries to relax with the Sunnis
Burkina Faso.summary: The release this Sunday, October 4, 2026, of approximately 80 supporters of Imam Mohamed Kindo is a political signal. Arrested at the end of May after a banned demonstration, shaved, and sent for training at the police camp, they are returning to their families. With video evidence, the junta is carefully staging a display of appeasement.

Burkina Faso.title: No to family war!
Burkina Faso.summary: We have VDPs on the battlefield against the forces of evil, but who are the VDPs in our families and where are they? We have been at war against terrorism for a decade but in our families, we shoot each other with live ammunition and at close range, among blood brothers, sometimes in deafening silence, sometimes with an unprecedented noise that attracts crowds .

Burkina Faso.title: Terrorists’ Illicit Funding Streams Converge
Burkina Faso.summary: Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) amasses an estimated $100 million a year through a web of illicit activities that illustrates the way terrorism, organized crime and public corruption are connected. “Make no mistake, today illicit economies in the Sahel and West Africa are interlinked criminalities across borders,” David M. Luna, executive director of the International Coalition Against Illicit Economies (ICAIE), told a recent webinar hosted by the Nigerian Financial Intelligence Unit (NFIU).

Niger.title: Niger: Niger's Junta Tightens Its Grip On Free Expression
Niger.summary: Lawyer Tried on Bogus Charges; Journalist Feared Forcibly Disappeared A lawyer in Niger faces prosecution over comments about the army on social media while a prominent journalist and critic of the country's military junta is being held in secret, with authorities refusing to identify his alleged offense. These cases together highlight a broadening crackdown in Niger, where the space for free expression is shrinking by the day.
